main_body: Flat snow ground patch (4x3 tiles) with gray-green base, pale blue-lavender patches and white speckles; no standing volume
top_band: none - terrain tile pattern with no standing object, no top/front split
evidence: The image is a seamless ground texture, not a standing object. The 3/4 contract for standing objects does not apply to terrain. The kind matches terrain. No isometric side faces and no front elevation are drawn.

style.evidence: The pattern has about 4 tones: dark green-gray, mid gray-green, light blue-lavender, and white. The dark horizontal dashes read as near-black tinted green-gray bars and are not true outlines. The pattern is highly regular and repetitive with an obvious tiling look of identical blue blobs and white dot clusters, which is mechanical next to the Beodeul grass and paving, where each stone and tuft is shaded individually. The lavender patches are fairly flat fills of about 5x5 px with only slight edge variation. Overall it has less organic variation and less grain than the references, and it reads as a stamped pattern rather than snow drifts. Per-tile colour count is probably around 5-6, below the reference median of about 10.
